title: Signing in to a Celerp account
summary: Web Access links this installation to a Celerp account, the sign-in Connect, backups, the module marketplace and Celerp AI's free questions all use.

steps.text: {get} opens the Celerp Connect page, which lists what the subscription adds, such as {backup} and {web}, and takes you to checkout.

Once you subscribe, this page shows Celerp Connect as active with your team's address. To change your card, see your invoices or cancel the subscription, ask the assistant for a link to the billing portal.

Open {access} from Settings. If you already subscribed on the Celerp website, use {connect} to link that account to this installation; the same account unlocks Celerp Connect, cloud backups, the module marketplace and Celerp AI's free questions.
